accepted.quote: Committee Democrats strongly oppose H.R. 5214. The bill would amend District of Columbia (D.C.) law to require, in the case of certain crimes, pretrial detention based solely on a charge and financial conditions on pretrial release.
accepted.rationale: The passage states strong opposition to a bill mandating charge-based pretrial detention and financial release conditions.

accepted.quote: Instead of meddling in local D.C. matters, Congress should pass the D.C. statehood bill.
accepted.rationale: The passage explicitly calls for Congress to pass D.C. statehood legislation rather than intervene in local matters.
